note: Alkapuri, on GJ SH 11. There is no footpath, so people walk on the road. Debris at the roadside blocks the flat surface a ramp would need, and a dead, leaning tree stands beside it.
Footpath at the bus station has no ramp. A kerb runs along the path, and fallen leaves, a signpost and a leaning tree sit at the edge.
Harni Airport Road in the monsoon. The road is highly uneven: the edge is broken and eroded. Water from a hillside stream runs across the road surface during the rains.

street: Side road near Harni Airport Road
note: Side road near Harni Airport Road has no ramps (noted by the surveyor on site). The photo shows the wet ground beside the road in the monsoon, not the missing ramp itself.
Median with mismatched paving: slabs and bricks of different sizes and colours, with gaps and different heights. Seen from above.
Back side of the railway station. The entrance is reached only by a flight of steps with a handrail. No ramp is visible.

There is no footpath or side road at all here, so people have to walk on the road. The asphalt edge is broken, electricity poles stand at the roadside, and the road is wet in the monsoon. Photographed from a car.
Ramps are disconnected from the footpath and there are no slopes on the footpath. Vinoba Bhave Rd, Sayaji Baug, near Kala Ghoda and Dak Bunglow.
Tiles broken on the ramp. Sayaji Baug Zoo.
No footpath: people walk on the road. A drain grate sits in the road surface, and the surface is patched and stained. Seen from above.
Highly uneven path with no flat surface in the monsoon. Muddy ground and standing water cover the path, and a food stall and cart take up part of the width.
